connector.name: loc8n Geographic Data
connector.registryDescription: U.S. demographics, housing, mortgage, migration, and employment data via loc8n API
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.loc8n.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-geographic-data. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gener8v-thomas account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token — your loc8n API key

env.description: API key for the loc8n Geographic Data API
